ki_gaps: CRITICAL: KI tools generate v4 .npt format but binary is v5 (reads .csv). generate_w2_control.py outputs w2_con.npt but w2_v5 expects w2_con.csv with completely different structure (1045-line positional CSV vs fixed-width card groups)

CRITICAL: KI has no tool or documentation for the v5 w2_con.csv format. The 1045-line CSV is position-dependent with ~60 card groups whose sizes depend on constituent counts. No example template or generator exists in the KI.
